acceptance: The frozen file list for this scope is revision-bound, individually assigned by the scope policy, and has no overlap with another task.

Every file in scope reaches zero discretionary comments and explanatory docstrings, with directives and notices kept only where registered with their consumer and necessity; no skips, xfails, weakened assertions, lowered thresholds or broadened ignores.

Prose-source assertions, including the two named in the description, are replaced by behavior or metadata cases before the text they read is deleted; rejected cases and nonempty coverage are preserved.
Source-only slices pass the parity comparator; any change beyond comment and docstring removal is a separate disclosed slice.
The wave pull request records exact base and head, the paths changed, the checks run and their results, and any soundness-path files carved out into their own pull requests.
context: Created 2026-10-02 from delivery plan v2 (/tmp/benchbox-comment-cleanup-plan-v2.md, decision D4): split from comment-cleanup-cross-module-unit-tests. Sibling items: comment-cleanup-unit-tests-core and comment-cleanup-unit-tests-cli-scripts-rest. Counts come from the ownership manifest at develop 2026-10-02; refresh at dispatch.
description:
Exclusive candidate scope (one third of the former comment-cleanup-cross-module-unit-tests, about 9,000 comments and docstrings in about 200 files at the 2026-10-02 base): everything under tests/unit/platforms/ except the root test files whose names start with test_a, test_b or test_c, which belong to comment-cleanup-unit-tests-core. That covers the platform subdirectories (dataframe, base, aws, credentials, onehouse, gcp, azure, databricks, cloud_spark, pyspark) and the root test files from test_d onward. The exact path assignment is made by the scope policy rules (quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json) in the delivery plan's scope-completion step; freeze the file list individually before dispatch and exclude every other task's manifest.

Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Required work and decisions: Replace prose-source assertions (tests that read docstring or source text of production code) with meaningful behavior or advertised-metadata cases, and preserve rejected cases and nonempty coverage. In this scope tests/unit/platforms/base/test_ddl_helpers.py requires strip_primary_keys.__doc__ to mention the string-literal limitation, and tests/unit/platforms/credentials/test_singlestore_credentials.py requires the singlestore credentials module docstring to contain "even when validation"; migrate each contract and change its assertion in the same wave as its producer or earlier. Unknown source readers block deletion. Source-only Python slices prove parity with the comparator delivered by the checker item. Delete filler and false claims; move necessary contracts to owning references before deleting source text. Executable simplification, typing or behavior changes need a separate approved and reviewed slice, with no new abstraction solely to house prose.

Module work lands through an integration branch with one PR into develop, as defined in the dispatch contract in docs/development/comment-cleanup-scope.md; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Required native or external soundness review remains mandatory for any soundness-manifest path, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud or stress test, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting or unapproved external-repository write.
